android-pairing.description: First-run QR pairing; camera is requested only when scanning.

default.description: Main window: core IPC (events for live updates). App commands are allowed by default; link opening goes through the app's own `open_link` command, which only accepts http(s)/mailto. `t76` is the real-webview harness's window (src/t76.rs: debug Linux builds only, with UNI_T76_DIR set), so pages driven there get live events too.

desktop-fullscreen.description: T-335: a full-screen video takes the whole window full screen where the webview refuses its own full screen, and gives it back on close.

desktop-notifications.description: Mention notifications and the unread badge on desktop.

desktop-updates.description: Signed background updates on desktop; the updater plugin does not support mobile.

interfaces.description: T-305: an installed interface's own window (`iface-<id>`). Live events only: no clipboard, notifications or other plugins. App commands pass the shell's own gate, which allows only what the person granted that interface (src/iface.rs).
